name: ui-test-agent
description: ui-test-agent: turn a test case into a stable amoo flow and a generated UI test, with or without a mock server.

plugins.name: ui-test-agent
plugins.description: Turn a test case into a stable amoo flow and a generated XCUITest or Compose/Espresso test, against the app's real backend or a moqserver session: the ui-test-agent subagent and the writing-ui-tests, mocking-with-moqserver and onboarding-an-app skills. Requires the amoo CLI and this repo's uita, amoo-ext-moq and amoo-ext-auth; moqserver only for mocked cases.
